text: The Patriots head to Miami this Sunday at 4:15 PM ET to face the Dolphins with their starting secondary healthy and ready to go, though the team will be looking to bounce back after dropping a 30-24 decision to Caleb Williams and the Bears on Thursday—a loss that underscored one of Mike Vrabel's core pillars: the Patriots are struggling with turnover differential when they need it most. The good news is that New England appears to have a viable survivor pool pick this week according to ESPN's rankings, and Rob Gronkowski's Hall of Fame induction ceremony will provide a celebratory respite the following Saturday at Patriot Place, though first things first, the Patriots must tighten up their ball security and execution against a division rival while Rhamondre Stevenson continues his steady work in the backfield, closing in on 100 carries for the sixth consecutive season.
